messages.text: Sorry to bother you this is my 3rd follow up now regarding my DC06 and seeing if a new PSU needs to be sent out. Last contact date was 9/26 with no update or follow up since.
Used the store-orders skill

Looked something up in Shopify
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)
Handed to the team · No record of a PSU-only replacement decision; customer chasing for the third tim

Sorry you've had to chase this three times.

Here's what I can see: on Shop···· a replacement DC06 shipped on September 29 and is in transit, tracking here — (tracking link hidden)

What I don't see is any decision recorded on the separate PSU, so I won't guess. I've put it in front of the team now, they're on until 6pm ET. Stay in the chat and one of them will answer here, or by email if you step away.
Possibly a faulty PSU

Could be. Quickest check: swap the PSU for another one of the same rating if you have a spare, if the miner boots on that, the PSU is the fault and a PSU-only replacement goes out, no need to return the whole unit.

Was that unit ever overclocked? Tampered or overclocked units aren't covered, so I have to ask.

To start the replacement formally, the RMA intake is here: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/12t6skK21Qb8GfAdUQ9nOhJ1tVINJ60T3AIAsyhBwnYM/viewform

The team has the PSU question too.
No I was told to hold off on RMA until told it is PSU

Understood, then hold off, I won't push the form.

Fastest way to get it confirmed as the PSU is JD on our Discord: https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf — post the symptoms and tag @nullhashrate (shown as JD, Admin). He answers hardware there all day.

The team already has your chase from this chat too, so you'll get it here or by email either way.

What's the unit actually doing, no lights at all, or it powers up and drops out?
No hashing power
Handed to the team · Needs JD to confirm PSU vs board before RMA; customer was told to hold off on th

Powers on but zero hashrate is often a PSU that can't hold current under load, the board boots on standby then the hashboard never ramps. A known-good supply of the same rating is the one test that settles it.

I've sent it to JD with that symptom so he can call PSU or board. He's on now and will come into this chat, or email you if you step away.

Is it showing zero in the web dashboard, or just no shares at the pool?
Zero in the web

Zero on the dashboard itself means the controller is alive and the hashboard isn't coming up, which is exactly the PSU-under-load picture. Worth checking the board's power leads are fully seated while you wait, that's the other common cause of the same reading.

I've passed that detail to JD, it's the bit he needs to call PSU versus board. He'll answer here, or by email if you've stepped away.
Do you guys accept unopened returns
Used the heliumdeploy-ops-knowledge skill

Shipped units can come back, yes, but it's handled case by case and the refund only follows once the unit lands back at the warehouse. Some lines are marked final sale at checkout, so it depends which one.

Which unit are you thinking of, the second DC06 or something else? Tell me that and I'll get you a straight yes or no on it rather than a general rule.
QX
Ran order_status.py (store-orders skill)

Got it, the NerdQX on Shop····. One went out September 22, so that's a shipped unit, which means it's a return rather than a cancellation: Georges signs those off and the refund only happens once the unit is back at the warehouse.

Is it still sealed and unopened? Say yes and I'll put it straight to him with the order number so he can confirm the return and the label.
Completely sealed and unopened from post office.
Handed to the team · Return of a shipped unit needs Georges to approve the label and the refund; disp

Perfect, sealed makes it straightforward. I've sent it to Georges with the order number and the tracking, so he can authorise the return label.

Two things worth knowing while he looks: store credit back on your account is usually quicker than a card refund, and either way the money moves once the unit reaches the warehouse. Tell me which you'd prefer and I'll note it for him.

He's on until 6pm ET and will come into this chat.
If someone can contact me I'll be available all day to get things resolved.

Noted, and that's passed on. Both items are in front of them now: JD on whether the DC06 needs a PSU, Georges on the NerdQX return.

They're on until 6pm ET today and will come into this chat. If you step away, the answer goes to (email hidden), and a copy of this whole conversation lands there once we close out, so nothing gets lost.

I'll stay with it in the meantime.
